derived_from: events.json's gt-inj-ser rows, moved onto reads at least MIN_READ_S apart (D4-47)
clock: received_utc, the read time: the platform's receive time of the read that returned the row
pass: zero departure alarms before baseline_ack; each departure with expect_rules raises at least its own kind's rule citing its events (absence: within the gap); recall per kind is reported; precision is alarms citing an injected departure over all departure alarms; expected_alarms is B6's reading under params.

controls.what: a first-read backlog in the observation period, repeats_n + 1 rows of every SER type at one received time: type-only (D4-9), so the baseline learns the types and nothing else from it, and the repeats and rate departures on gt-inj-ser still alarm

a gap-before backlog after the acknowledgement, more than the repeats and rate bounds of a known type at an hour it was never seen in: type-only (D4-9), so it raises no repeats, rate or time alarm; the new type read with it still alarms (its departure has catch_up)
